candidates.headline: Kenneth Walker III, Patrick Mahomes lead Chiefs' win vs. Broncos
candidates.description: Quarterback Patrick Mahomes, making his return from a torn ACL, and running back Kenneth Walker III, making his Chiefs debut, powered Kansas City to a season-opening blowout win over Denver.

candidates.headline: Sources: Joey Porter Jr. unlikely to play amid uncertain Steelers future
candidates.description: Steelers cornerback Joey Porter Jr., who has been embroiled in a contract dispute all summer, is unlikely to play against the Falcons because of a back injury, sources told NFL Network and ESPN, and the possibility of a trade remains in play.

candidates.headline: Sources: Maxx Crosby shut down Rams trade talks after failed Ravens deal
candidates.description: The Rams pursued Maxx Crosby shortly after his trade from the Raiders to the Ravens fell through, sources told NFL Network.

candidates.headline: Source: Jaguars, Parker Washington unlikely to agree to deal
candidates.description: The Jaguars and Parker Washington are unlikely to agree to a contract extension before the start of the season, a source told NFL Network.

candidates.headline: Sources: Lamar Jackson won't have deal before start of season
candidates.description: Lamar Jackson has been reluctant to discuss a long-term extension with the Ravens and has been more focused on the upcoming 2026 season, league sources told ESPN.

candidates.headline: Sources: C.J. Stroud, Texans to table extension talks
candidates.description: The Texans and C.J. Stroud made a run at completing a contract extension before the regular season begins, but both sides agreed they now prefer to wait until after this season to work out a long-term deal, sources told ESPN and NFL Network.

candidates.headline: Raiders TE Michael Mayer gets 3-year, $45M extension, sources say
candidates.description: Tight end Michael Mayer, who is stepping in for an injured Brock Bowers to start the regular season, has received a multiyear extension from the Raiders.

candidates.headline: Sources: Packers, TE Tucker Kraft agree to 4-year extension
candidates.description: The Packers and tight end Tucker Kraft have reached agreement on a four-year extension worth up to $92 million, sources told ESPN.

candidates.headline: Sources: Bears, RB Swift agree to 3-year, $33.75M extension
candidates.description: The Bears and running back D'Andre Swift have reached an agreement on a three-year, $33.75 million extension that includes $27.5 million guaranteed, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

candidates.headline: Texans rookie Kayden McDonald placed on IR with ankle injury
candidates.description: Texans rookie defensive tackle Kayden McDonald (ankle) was placed on injured reserve, meaning he'll have to wait four weeks to make his debut.
